post.title: Furniture is up only 9% since 1993. So why does it feel pricey?
post.ig:
Furniture prices are up only about 9% since 1993.

BLS furniture and bedding prices rose 9.3% from 1993 to 2026, while overall prices rose about 130%.
Then in 2022 alone, furniture jumped 12.19% versus 8.00% for all items.
Since Oct 14, 2025, imported upholstered furniture from most countries faces a 25% tariff; a hike to 30% is delayed to Jan 2027.

Sources: BLS CPI (via officialdata.org, in2013dollars.com), Sept 29 and Dec 31, 2025 presidential proclamations (ABC News, CNN).
News and education, not financial advice.
